title: Rehousing a dirty AND with wires fails: in some AND/OR edge circuit, zeroing it and serving lost edges by stars and wire-widened tops exceeds the count
formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (g : ℕ) (St : Finset (Fin n)) (O : Fin n → Finset ℕ) (Tp : Finset ℕ) (bt : ℕ → Fin 2) (U : ℕ → Finset ℕ) (Z Fo Dd : Finset ℕ), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅ → g ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.junk G C → (∀ c ∈ St, (O c).Nonempty ∧ ∀ w ∈ O c, (w < n ∨ (n ≤ w ∧ w - n < C.gates.length ∧ w - n ≠ g ∧ w - n ∉ Dd)) ∧ ∀ x : Fin n → Bool, PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n C w x = true → ∃ q : Fin n, G.Adj c q ∧ x q = true) → (∀ T ∈ Tp, T < C.gates.length ∧ T ≠ g ∧ T ∉ Dd ∧ T ∉ Fo ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C T).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ PEqualNP.TopForm.BelowF G C T ∧ PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches n C C.output T ∧ (U T).Nonempty ∧ ∀ u ∈ U T, u < n + T ∧ (n ≤ u → u - n ≠ g ∧ u - n ∉ Dd) ∧ ∀ x : Fin n → Bool, PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n C (PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd C T (1 - bt T)) x = true → PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n C u x = true → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅ x = true) → (∀ a b : Fin n, G.Adj a b → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n ⟨C.gates.set g ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, []⟩, C.output⟩ (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput a b) = false → (∃ c ∈ St, (c = a ∨ c = b) ∧ ∃ w ∈ O c, PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n ⟨C.gates.set g ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, []⟩, 0⟩ w (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput a b) = true) ∨ ∃ T ∈ Tp, PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n ⟨C.gates.set g ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, []⟩, 0⟩ (PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd C T (1 - bt T)) (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput a b) = true ∧ ∃ u ∈ U T, PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n ⟨C.gates.set g ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, []⟩, 0⟩ u (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput a b) = true) → (∀ j ∈ Z, j = g ∨ (j < C.gates.length ∧ j ∉ Dd ∧ j ∉ Tp ∧ (((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ ∃ i ∈ Z, n + i ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).inputs) ∨ ∀ w ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).inputs, ∃ i ∈ Z, w = n + i))) → (∀ j ∈ Fo, j < C.gates.length ∧ j ≠ g ∧ j ∉ Dd ∧ ∃ i ∈ Z, n + i ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).inputs) → (∀ j ∈ Dd, j < C.gates.length ∧ j ≠ g ∧ C.output ≠ n + j) → (∀ k < C.gates.length, k ≠ g → k ∉ Dd → ∀ j : ℕ, n + j ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C k).inputs → j ∉ Dd) → ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n D ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n D = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅ ∧ (PEqualNP.TopForm.junk G D).card < (PEqualNP.TopForm.junk G C).card ∧ D.size + 1 + Dd.card + Fo.card + (Tp.filter (fun T => ∃ i ∈ Z, PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd C T (bt T) = n + i)).card ≤ C.size + ∑ c ∈ St, ((O c).card + 1) + ∑ T ∈ Tp, (U T).card)
plain_statement: False: C: AND/OR, two earlier wires per gate, for a graph's edge function F; g a dirty AND, zeroed. Each lost edge is served by a star x_c & OR(O c) (c in St an end; O c wires not g, not in Dd, below OR N(c)) or by a top T in Tp (AND below F, ORs to output; not g, Dd, Fo) widened by wires U(T) (earlier than T, not g, not in Dd; T's other operand & u below F), true there. Dd: gates read only by g or Dd; Fo: readers of wires forced false; k: tops whose widened operand is forced false. Then F has an AND/OR circuit with fewer dirty ANDs and <= |C|-1-|Dd|-|Fo|-k+sum_St(|O c|+1)+sum_Tp|U(T)| gates.

counterexample.description: Its literal negation pair, L-meta-5407, is checked (run-048955); recorded by the hub in the same act.

faithful.note: Negation of L-meta-5407's term (script); its sentence repeats 5407's missing Dd and Fo clauses; refile with it.

corrections.note: The term asks more of Dd and Fo than the sentence says: Dd's gates are gates other than g and the output (read only by g or by Dd); Fo's gates are gates other than g and not in Dd, each reading a wire the zero forces false.
